title: Ambient Sound Translation
sonic_description: Atmospheric, spacious, slowly evolving ambient texture
why: Very long attack creates gradual fade-in. Long reverb tail creates wash and atmosphere. Low filter resonance keeps sound smooth. Noise oscillator adds texture without harshness.
how_to_apply: Use for background textures, drones, and atmospheric pads. Long attack (1s+) is key. Combine delay and reverb for layered space. Keep resonance low to avoid piercing frequencies.
